title: a16z Podcast: Why Crypto Tokens Matter

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: with Chris Dixon and Fred Ehrsam We’ve already talked about why bitcoin matters.
reader_summary.overview: with Chris Dixon and Fred Ehrsam We’ve already talked about why bitcoin matters. But as the set of cryptocurrencies — and networks and “tokens” enabled by the underlying blockchain — grow (Ethereum being one of the fastest-growing ones). How do we tease apart the signal from the noise, given all the buzz and critiques out there?
